title: Runtime failure context sampler and anomaly storyboard
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a single operational view that ties slow traces, model inference failures, overloaded queues, and HTTP/gRPC status codes into human-readable failure stories. When an application experiences elevated tail latency or increased 500s, on-call currently chases separate signals (traces, host metrics, model logs) without a taxonomy that maps observability signals to operational root causes.

Goal: Build a lightweight "Failure Context Sampler" that enriches sampled traces with a compact failure taxonomy and surrounding metrics (queue length, GPU utilization, model error codes). Surface that data in a new "Anomaly Storyboard" dashboard that groups incidents by inferred cause (timeout, backpressure/overload, model runtime error, protocol error) and shows representative trace, logs, metric trend, and suggested remediation steps.

Scope: instrument tracing hooks to attach failure tags and sampled metric snapshots; extend metrics/log pipeline to emit a compact failure envelope; create Grafana/Console storyboard panels and three canonical query widgets for each failure category. Do not attempt full-ML incident classification in this ticket; keep inference rules deterministic and explainable.

Trade-offs and decisions:
- Sampling rate: start with 1% global, 5% on error paths; increase dynamically for SLO breaches. Keeping sampling deterministic avoids sudden cost spikes.
- Enrichment payload: emit a small envelope (<=512 bytes) to logs/metrics to avoid high cardinality. Heavy fields (full model outputs) are only attached for P0 incidents.
- Failure taxonomy: limited to a concise set: timeout, overload/backpressure, model-exception (runtime model failures like CUDA OOM or invalid logits), protocol-error (HTTP/gRPC codes like 4xx/5xx mapping), and degraded-quality (model hallucination / semantic failures flagged by eval hooks).

Implementation notes: tracing hook lives in runtime request path (pre-inference, post-inference, error-hook). Pipeline transforms map envelope -> time-series labels + one enriched log event. Dashboard groups by failure_reason label and exposes representative trace link and sample log id.

Expected deliverables:
- Tracing hook PR with sampling policy and envelope schema (runtime + agent).
- Log/metrics transform in ingestion pipeline with durable mapping tests.
- Grafana/Console storyboard dashboard + alert rule examples.
- Runbook additions and on-call playbook snippets.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Platform emits 'failure_envelope' for error-path traces with taxonomy tag and metric snapshot at 95th percentile; 2) Anomaly Storyboard dashboard can group incidents by failure_reason and link to representative trace+log; 3) Alerting rule for correlated tail latency + queue growth triggers with <=5% false positive in 2 week pilot; 4) Observability costs increase <10% in pilot region; 5) Runbook contains actionable remediation steps for each taxonomy class.
tasks: Add tracing hooks in runtime request pipeline with failure_envelope schema
Update sampling policy: 1% global, 5% on error path, dynamic increase for SLO breach
Implement ingestion transform to convert envelope into metric labels and enriched log
Create Anomaly Storyboard dashboard in Grafana/Console with grouping and drilldowns
Write runbook entries and example remediation playbooks
Add unit/integration tests for envelope size and transform correctness
Pilot in us-west-2 with two services (inference-api, routing-proxy)
trace_sampling_policy: Start: default 1% sampled traces. Error-paths force-sample (5%) when status != OK or when runtime raises exception. Dynamic policy: when service tail latency > SLO for 5m, scale trace sample rate up to 10% for 30m. Enrich sampled spans with labels: failure_reason, model_version, gpu_id, queue_length_at_request, kv_cache_hit (true/false).
rollout_plan: 1) Merge tracing hook PR behind feature flag. 2) Enable feature in staging and run 48h pilot. 3) Deploy ingestion transform and dashboard in staging. 4) Canary roll to us-west-2 for inference-api + routing-proxy for 7 days. 5) Evaluate cost, false positive rate, and refine thresholds. 6) Gradual rollout to remaining regions if pilot OK.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Increased observability cost from richer traces and envelopes. Mitigation: strict envelope size cap (512 bytes), deterministic sampling, and automatic throttle if ingestion cost exceeds budget. Risk: tag explosion causing high-cardinality metrics. Mitigation: map free-text error messages to a small taxonomy server-side before labeling. Risk: incomplete mapping of model-exception types. Mitigation: start with common runtime failures (OOM, nan/inf outputs, model-load-fail) and iterate.
